title: An Agent-based Evaluation Framework for Complex Code Generation
rationale: 用多代理评判复杂代码生成，与人类评分计算相关；支持独立评判器质量检查。

title: GraphDroid: Asynchronous LLM-Based Mobile App GUI Testing via History-Aware Exploration and Hybrid Intent Fulfillment
rationale: 将移动 GUI 测试的探索与意图生成异步化，报告未知问题的开发者确认数。

title: Demystifying Memorization in LLM-based Program Repair via a General Hypothesis Testing Framework
rationale: 对程序修复中的记忆效应做假设检验，发现既有判据难区分解题和背诵。

title: Every Scenario Matters: Scenario-Guided White-Box Testing for Static Code Checkers Powered by LLMs
rationale: 面向静态检查器生成情境测试并比较多个检查器差异，可验证质量门禁工具自身。

title: Accurate and Low-Cost Residual Risk Assessment via Sampled Profiling and Structure-Aware Coverage Amplification
rationale: 在覆盖采样预算下校正残余风险，对比真实值与相同时间内检出的缺陷，关联停止门槛。

title: Hierarchical Knowledge Injection for Improving LLM-based Program Repair
rationale: 分层加入修复所需知识，比较一次给全量上下文与逐层配置在 314 个问题上的效果。

title: Productively Deploying Emerging Models on Emerging Platforms: A Top-Down Approach for Testing and Debugging
rationale: 跨新平台部署模型的真实案例把正确性检查与开发工作联系起来，不能把设备数量当节省工时。

title: Program Feature-based Benchmarking for Fuzz Testing
rationale: 将程序特征和工具表现关联，发现工具名次取决于基准构成，影响平台选型。

title: Barista: Synthesizing Typestate Specifications with LLM Agents
rationale: 用文档、LLM 和类型系统提取库对象协议，替代部分手工注解并实施编译时检查。

title: SE-Jury: An LLM-as-Ensemble-Judge Metric for Narrowing the Gap with Human Evaluation in SE
rationale: 将五类评判策略交给独立模型判断后与人类评价比较，有助检验自动裁决偏差。
